citations.title: Metabolic effects of a growth hormone-releasing factor in patients with HIV.
Long-term safety and effects of tesamorelin, a growth hormone-releasing factor analogue, in HIV patients with abdominal fat accumulation.

answer.text: In a 26‑week randomized trial of HIV‑infected adults, daily tesamorelin reduced visceral adipose tissue by about 18% and lowered triglycerides by 51 mg/dL, with no clinically significant worsening of glucose; adverse events were similar to placebo, though more tesamorelin patients withdrew because of an adverse event. [1][4]
